messages:
alex-partners: Quick thread: NovaWeights asking for marketplace listing + reseller/SI bundle strategy. They also want a revenue-share proposal and a "Redwood Verified" provenance badge. Can we scope what we need to accept them and what we require for co-selling?

nina-ops: Ops checklist I'm thinking: model_card, sbom for weights and compile tools, ancestry hash chain (weights -> quant -> package), signed artifact manifest, export classification, privacy/PII statement, eval harness results (toxicity + safety), recommended quant profiles. Also: provide sample inference key for perf tests.

rachel-legal: We need to confirm license grants. Current draft allows hosting but prohibits redistribution to third parties. For reseller/SI bundles we must have a reseller addendum with explicit rev-share, indemnity carve-outs, and export controls. I'll draft a short addendum template, but need to know desired rev-share bands from biz/dev.

alex-partners: Marketing asks for suggested quote + logo usage terms in the partner pack. They also want a 30-day embargo on any joint press unless we do a staged announce.

sam-eng: Engineering asks: will NovaWeights allow us to ship a quantized artifact? If not, permission to quantize is mandatory. Also need the tokenizer spec (their bpe variant) and a streaming shim test vector. Perf target: p50 < 45ms and p95 < 220ms on our 1xA100 ref with seq=512 for the hosted SKU.

mike-infra: For SI on-prem bundles we require an image manifest: list of artifacts + sha256 + provenance signature. We accept either PGP-signed manifests or signing via our onboarding HSM. Example requirement snippet: 
```
image_manifest_v2: true
artifacts:
  - name: weights.tar.gz
    sha256: <hex>
  - name: tokenizer.json
    sha256: <hex>
signature: <pgp-or-hsm-base64>
```
If provider can't provide HSM key rotate, PGP ok but add 2-week manual review.

nina-ops: Also confirming marketplace SKU naming rules: partner.<provider>.<model>.<quant> e.g., partner.novaweights.neo13b.q4_0b. We need SKU metadata: regions, allowed_resellers (list), price_band, support_contact.

alex-partners: Business: Nova asked for 20/80 rev-share (provider 20%, Redwood 80%) for hosted usage and 35/65 for reseller-on-prem bundles. That sounds high for them — can we propose standard bands?

rachel-legal: Revenue share isn't legal's call but we need to include payment terms, audit rights, and termination triggers (license revocation clause triggered by export violation or provenance mismatch).

sam-eng: SDK compatibility: if tokenizer is nonstandard we need to ship a compatibility wrapper in our SDKs. Also need to validate that quantization doesn't alter top-k outputs beyond a small delta — we'll run an A/B metric: top1 match and logp drift.

mike-infra: Security asks for model fingerprinting telemetry contract: minimal telemetry only (latency/error codes) and a hashed model ID. No sample-level logging. Provider must attest they strip training data PII from any logging.

alex-partners: Marketing-bot: auto: created partner-campaign/novaweights ticket #PRT-4456 (owner: alex-partners).

nina-ops: Timeline proposal: week 0: legal addendum + provenance artifacts; week 1: ops perf + quant tests; week 2: infra manifest validation and HSM key rotation; week 3: marketplace ingestion + marketing assets; week 4: partner QA + soft-launch to SI partners; week 6: public listing. Is everyone comfortable?

rachel-legal: I can get a first addendum draft in 48 hours if alex shares the provider contact and the list of resellers. Need the base license text too.

alex-partners: Sharing contact ops@novaweights.ai and license_v1.pdf just uploaded to /shared/partners/nova/contract. Alex will ask them to confirm rev-share expectations and provide the SBOM + tokenizer spec by tomorrow.

sam-eng: I'll prep the quantization bench and a compatibility shim skeleton. If they refuse permission to quantize we need a fallback play (host fp16 only + higher price band).

mike-infra: I'll start a validation script repo (internal) and post CI instructions. Also note: for EU sales we may need geoblocking metadata on the SKU if their export attestation restricts EU hosting. Please flag region constraints early.

alex-partners: OK. Action items summary: 1) Rachel draft reseller addendum; 2) Alex to confirm rev-share and get SBOM/tokenizer; 3) Nina run perf once artifacts in; 4) Sam prep SDK shim; 5) Mike build manifest validator. Friday standup check-in. Tag me if anything blocks. :white_check_mark:
